summary: Arqit Quantum Inc., a Nasdaq-listed UK foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, carrying a press release announcing select preliminary unaudited financial results for the second half and full fiscal year ended September 30, 2026. Management guided H2 revenue of roughly $355,000-$380,000 and full-year revenue of $975,000-$1,000,000, with cash and cash equivalents near $51 million. H2 revenue fell versus $463,000 a year earlier, hurt by ceased recognition on a Middle East contract affected by geopolitical events. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings update. Watch for audited results, contract delivery risk, and the Middle East customer's ability to perform.
